name: ram-monitor
title: RAM Monitor
description: See your Mac's RAM usage and memory pressure at a glance, plus which apps use the most memory.
author: boch-rvf

commands.name: ram-usage
commands.title: RAM Usage
commands.description: Show RAM usage, memory pressure, and the apps using the most memory in the menu bar.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
